title: Policeman Bluejay
summary: "Policeman Bluejay" by L. Frank Baum is a children's novel published in 1907. When two children become lost in a great forest, an evil magical creature transforms them into bird-like beings with human heads and skylark bodies. Guided by Policeman Bluejay, they explore the avian world, discovering its structure, beauty, and dangers.
